responsibility: This definition file lists the AdvSIMD/NEON scalar and vector C types that the AArch64 builtin machinery exposes, including signed, unsigned, polynomial, floating-point, and bfloat16 forms. Each ENTRY associates a type name with a GCC machine mode, qualifier class, and metadata used by builtin registration so that the SIMD builtin implementation can generate consistent function signatures and type nodes from a compact table.
